title: Pretty Pickle
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Pretty Pickle Camp is a relaxed and welcoming outpost on the dusty road to nowhere. We have daily afternoon cold pickle service for the Black Rock City community (noon to 3 p.m., Monday through Saturday). We invite passersby to step under our shade, enjoy a refreshing treat, and ride our disco pickle swing!
